quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on managing Kawhi Leonard's absence during games
quotes.excerpt: It's always you got to be ready for those situations and adjust and try to maximize the opportunity
quotes.quote: It's a part of the game. It's not the first time that happened in my career, and definitely it's not the last one. It's always you got to be ready for those situations and adjust and try to maximize the opportunity for the other guys in that situation. Obviously, he's a big part of what we do over here and missing him was a big on us, but it's a great opportunity for everybody else to step up.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on playing without Kawhi Leonard: It is a part of the game. It is not the first time that happened in my career and definitely it is not the last one. You have to be ready for those situations and adjust.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic discusses how the team manages the game when Kawhi Leonard is unavailable.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Scotty Barnes' performance against Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: I don't think they did anything to be honest with you that they got him off the game
quotes.quote: I don't think they did anything to be honest with you that they got him off the game. He just missed his shots. All the shots that he took in the game, I thought they were good shots. And this is not going to happen again to Scotty. Scotty is going to make those shots next time. So I didn't see anything special that they did to him to get him off the balance.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says Scottie Barnes missing shots against Minnesota was not about the defense. I do not think they did anything to get him off the game. He just missed his shots. Scotty is going to make those shots next time.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic defends Scottie Barnes performance after he struggled to make shots against the Timberwolves.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic evaluates Jacob's performance and aggression
quotes.excerpt: He was himself, he was aggressive, we continued looking for him at the three-point line
quotes.quote: Jacob, he started the game, he missed a couple of shots. After that, he was himself, he was aggressive, we continued looking for him at the three-point line. He continued doing a good job of getting open and then getting shots off. I thought he did a good job tonight.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on Jacob's performance: He started the game, he missed a couple of shots. After that, he was himself, he was aggressive. I thought he did a good job tonight.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on team growth and shooting struggles
quotes.excerpt: We did some good stuff, we just did not make shots
quotes.quote: It's a game three of the season. It's a great opportunity for us to learn, to watch film, to see what are the areas that we can improve. Tonight we kept the team to nine offensive rebounds, we had 14, we turned them over 23 times. We did some good stuff, we just did not make shots. When you shoot 38% from the field and 26% from three-point line, it's hard to overcome that.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the Raptors shooting struggles: We did some good stuff, we just did not make shots. When you shoot 38 percent from the field and 26 percent from three point line, it is hard to overcome that.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic reflects on the team's shooting struggles and overall performance in the third game of the season.
